# AgentIO

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/logic/agents/`](../folders/src-logic-agents.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/agents/agent_io.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/agent_io.h)

## Summary

The world's agent as the training host sees it: behaviour, sizes, action in, observation / reward / done / stats out.

## Description

World context variable, one agent per world. Created on demand by agentIO(reg) (find or emplace), first by SphereControlSys::preinit; SphereControlSys::init calls configure(behavior, 16, 3), which sets sensor_name = "VectorSensor_size<obs>" and zero-fills action and observation. The host (WorldsEnvironment, PolicySys, SphereHeuristicSys, tests) writes `action` and `reset_requested` between windows; SphereObserveSys writes observation, reward, done, truncated and stats in the Observe phase; resetSphereEpisode zeroes action and clears reward / done / truncated / stats.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `behavior` | `std::string` | "" | behaviour name (checkpoints <behavior>-<step>.onnx) |
| `observation_size` | `int` | 0 | floats per observation |
| `action_size` | `int` | 0 | continuous actions |
| `sensor_name` | `std::string` | "" | VectorSensor_size<observation_size> |
| `action` | `std::vector<float>` | empty (action_size zeros after configure) | host to world: the decision for the coming window |
| `reset_requested` | `bool` | false | host to world: start a new episode at the next Observe phase (RESET) |
| `observation` | `std::vector<float>` | empty (observation_size zeros after configure) | world to host, written by the Observe phase |
| `reward` | `float` | 0 | mean per-tick reward over the window that just ended |
| `done` | `bool` | false | the episode ended with this observation |
| `truncated` | `bool` | false | ended by a limit (time, bounds), not a terminal state |
| `stats` | `std::vector<std::pair<std::string, float>>` | empty | this window's values, averaged by the host |
